finding: delivery-price deliveryTime labels the settlement date at 00:00 UTC; current exchangeInfo deliveryDate identifies quarterly expiry at 08:00 UTC. Treating deliveryTime as the event instant would expose the outcome eight hours early.
implementation: Match a published delivery-price record by UTC calendar date to the deterministic symbol expiry at 08:00 UTC. Preserve its original deliveryTime. Expose deliveryPrice only at the 08:00 exit event; never at the midnight date label. Missing or ambiguous date mapping is unknown, never synthesized from spot.
evidence: Capability probe raw response hashes retained; exchangeInfo current BTCUSDT_260925 and BTCUSDT_261225 both specify 08:00. Closed-quarter delivery records label their days at 00:00. No economic result or settlement price inspected to choose this interpretation.
impact: Clarifies timestamp semantics only; the registered expiry calendar, entry/exit policy, threshold and cost parameters remain unchanged.
